note: Every castle, wall, tower, house and hall in Crownfall's realm is placed from these six kit models (web/public/env). Each one is a single Aholo Lux3D text-to-3D task. Order is build order. (Trees are procedural geometry in web/src/realm/Forest.tsx, so they are not part of the kit.)

kit.what: the castle keep at the heart of each of the eight houses
kit.prompt: A square medieval castle keep with four round corner towers topped with conical terracotta-red tiled roofs, crenellated battlements, an arched wooden gate and arrow slits, pale weathered limestone, single isolated building, game asset

kit.what: every wall tower and gatehouse tower
kit.prompt: A round medieval castle tower of pale weathered limestone with crenellated battlements, arrow slits and a conical terracotta-red tiled roof, single isolated tower, game asset

kit.what: every stretch of castle and city wall
kit.prompt: A straight section of medieval castle curtain wall, a long rectangular block of pale weathered limestone with crenellated battlements along the top and flat cut ends, single isolated wall segment, game asset
A small medieval village cottage with white plaster walls, dark timber framing, a steep thatched straw roof and a stone chimney, single isolated building, game asset
A tall narrow two-storey medieval townhouse, half-timbered upper floor overhanging a stone ground floor, steep terracotta-red clay tile roof, single isolated building, game asset

kit.what: the great hall of the Ashen Throne in the capital
kit.prompt: A grand medieval great hall, a long pale limestone building with tall arched windows, buttresses and a steep dark slate roof, single isolated building, game asset
